title: Fields named or path-labelled with a PII category are redacted at the boundary regardless of call-site discipline
asA: operator concerned that PII leaks through logs
iWant: the emission boundary to redact fields with named PII categories automatically
soThat: a rogue caller that forgets to redact does not leak PII to the log destination

acceptanceCriteria.description: A log payload containing a field named or path-tagged with any of the recommended-default categories (credential, pii.email, pii.name, pii.address, token, bearer) is replaced with the literal string [REDACTED:<category>] in the emitted line; the caller's original object is not mutated (a subsequent read of the same object still shows the original value).
acceptanceCriteria.given: an emission at any level whose payload includes a field tagged as pii.email
acceptanceCriteria.when: the emission passes through the boundary
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's field value equals [REDACTED:pii.email] and the caller-side object still holds the original address

acceptanceCriteria.description: A project may add its own redaction categories at apply through the ADR-1603 elicited-additions parameter; a new category name (kebab or dotted-namespace) is accepted and applied by the boundary in the same round. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets any project-added redaction categories on the redaction-categories-additions elicit; the AC substitutes the project's category names for the illustrative ssn token.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that elicited an additional category ssn on ADR-1603
acceptanceCriteria.when: an emission includes a field tagged ssn
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's field value equals [REDACTED:ssn]

acceptanceCriteria.description: A category name whose kebab or dotted-namespace grammar looks valid but is not present in the current recommended-default set and not in the elicited additions is left unredacted; the emitted payload field carries its original value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application configured only with the recommended defaults and a caller emitting a payload with a field tagged `custom.internal.token` (not in defaults, not in elicited additions)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's `custom.internal.token` field carries the caller value verbatim; no [REDACTED:...] rewrite happens for that field

acceptanceCriteria.description: The redaction boundary reads a nested payload path: an object with a `user.pii.email` shape has the leaf redacted; the sibling `user.id` retains its original value. Template values the applying agent sets: the AC exercises the recommended-default category vocabulary configured on the boundary.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application with recommended defaults and a caller emitting `{ user: { id: "u-1", pii: { email: "a@b" } } }`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line has `user.id` equal to "u-1" and `user.pii.email` equal to "[REDACTED:pii.email]"
